questions: Have there been any changes to your medication list in the past year, particularly regarding your gastrointestinal symptoms?

events.value: heart rate increased to one hundred ten

preop_note_claims: Patient's medical history includes obesity (BMI 32), type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.
Current medications include metformin 500mg twice daily, lisinopril 20mg once daily, and atorvastatin 40mg once daily.
Patient has a true allergy to penicillin.
Ranitidine 150mg twice daily was discontinued 6 months ago due to resolution of GERD symptoms.
ASA-PS classification is 2, due to mild systemic disease (hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus).
Airway assessment and plan for general anesthesia with laryngeal mask airway (LMA) should be documented.
handoff_claims: Patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and obesity (BMI 32).
Intraoperative course: Elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy under general anesthesia with LMA, without complications.
Anticipated postoperative issues include potential delayed recovery due to obesity and diabetes, and need for glycemic control monitoring.
distractors: History of pneumonia resolved 5 years ago
Remote history of left arm fracture (healed) from 10 years ago
Previous use of Omeprazole for GERD, discontinued 2 years ago
